problemas: Dolor visual (7): el pantalón se ve como un pantalón ancho normal. En un segundo no se entiende que le queda grande, porque la pierna delgada no se ve y la mano casi no levanta tela.
revisadas.correccion_en: Keep everything else identical. Make the problem obvious at a glance: her hand pulls a big empty fold of the beige trousers far up and away from the thigh, showing a wide gap of air between fabric and leg; one trouser hem is pushed up so a visibly thin ankle and shin show inside the wide opening; the trousers must clearly look two sizes too big. Keep the texts exactly as they are.
